marine.title: Forecast for Today Tonight and Friday.
marine.text:
Wind north 20 knots diminishing to light this morning then
becoming east 15 this evening. Wind backing to north 15 late overnight then
diminishing to light Friday morning. Wind increasing to southeast 15 Friday
afternoon and to southeast 25 Friday evening. Scattered flurries ending near noon Friday. Visibility 1
mile or less in flurries. Temperatures minus 3 rising to plus 2 Friday
evening. <br/>

marine.text:

increasing to southwest 15 this evening. Wind veering to northwest 20 late
overnight then diminishing to light Friday morning. Wind increasing to south 25

less in flurries. Temperatures minus 1 rising to plus 5 near midnight then
falling to zero Friday morning. Temperatures rising to plus 5 Friday
evening. <br/>
